name: Keep On Steppin AI Dance
blurb: One group photo in: your whole crew steps at the camera in sync, then stomps right over the lens.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the starting frame and keep every person exactly as photographed: same faces, hair, skin tones, body shapes and outfits. The group stands in one row on an empty car park on a grey day, a green field and a line of autumn trees behind them. (1) They nod to the beat and fall into one straight line; (2) everyone does the Keep On Steppin line dance perfectly in sync, marching toward the camera with sharp step-touches, heel taps, a shoulder bounce and arms swinging low at their sides; (3) they keep stepping until the front dancer is right over the lens and the camera drops to the ground for a low-angle shot looking up as they stomp the last step together. If the photo is a close selfie, they first step back so full bodies are in frame. Phone camera on a tripod, full bodies in frame, one continuous shot, vertical 9:16. Upbeat line-dance beat in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

Phone camera on a tripod, full bodies in frame, one continuous shot, vertical 9:16. Upbeat line-dance beat in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos or brand names, no watermark.
